Night widens the threat range (synergy w/ Phase 150 NightDanger). Throttled sub-frame, defensive nulls, idempotent NotifyCombat refresh (no conflict w/ Combat/Boss). Wired via wire_playable_slice: TI_Audio(AudioManager engine, alone-on-object so its singleton-guard Destroy is harmless) + TI_MusicDirector(brain, own object). VERIFIED: recompile ok, missing_types=[], TI_Audio=[Transform,AudioManager], TI_MusicDirector=[Transform,MusicDirector], scene saved.
